correctness.rationale: PASS: for y0>0, lambda,h>0 and z=lambda h, cubic Hermite with exact endpoint value and derivatives has H_z(s)=1-zs+B(z)s²+A(z)s³. Differentiating including exp(-z) gives ∂_z H_z(s)=-s(1-s)²-e^-z s²[2-s+z(1-s)]<0 in interior. Its compact minimum strictly decreases continuously from 1 at z=0 to -infinity for z→infinity, yielding unique positivity threshold. Endpoint values positive force a unique interior even-multiplicity root at first contact; a cubic forces double root, and for z beyond it exactly two simple interior zeros. Nonzero ∂_z and positive curvature give square-root opening K=sqrt(-2 H_z/H_ss). Independent symbolic identity and numerical saddle reproduced z*=3.86930633627, s*=0.675694826 and K~0.336550838. Finite rational Bernstein certificates in verify.py were inspected but not mistaken for proof or fully replayed here.
